test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the descending order of Padma Awards?

options.text: Padma Shri, Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan
Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri, Padma Vibhushan
Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri
Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, Padma Vibhushan

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** are one of the highest civilian honors of **India**, instituted in **1954**.
